messages:
Elena (docs): FYI I found an inconsistency in the API ref for /v1/generate. The sample shows a single JSON response even when stream=true. That causes a lot of user confusion when clients get SSE.

Samir (eng-runtime): Confirmed. When stream=true we set Content-Type: text/event-stream and emit SSE frames. The events we use are 'partial' and 'done'. Each data: line is JSON with fields like "text" and "delta" (and sometimes "final" on done).

Tao (eng-ml): We should publish a canonical minimal SSE snippet and a non-streaming example (stream=false) side by side. Also add a brief migration note for integrators.

Ivy (product): Keep examples tiny. Customers want: 1) how to consume the stream, 2) how to opt out for a single JSON response. A short troubleshooting note about common parser mistakes would be helpful.

Elena (docs): I'll open a docs PR. Planned changes: swap the wrong JSON sample for an SSE curl example, add a minimal SSE sample block, add a stream=false curl example returning JSON, add Node and Python micro-snippets showing assembly of deltas, and a one-line migration blurb.

Elena (docs): Draft curl SSE example:
```bash
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}' "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true"
```

Elena (docs): Draft SSE payload sample:
```
event: partial
data: {"text":"Hel","delta":"Hel"}

event: partial
data: {"text":"lo","delta":"lo"}

event: done
data: {"text":"Hello","delta":"","final":true}
```

Elena (docs): Non-streaming example (stream=false):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# -> application/json single response with a text field
```

Elena (docs): Tiny Node snippet (illustrative):
```js
const stream = client.generateStream({model:'redwood-7b', input:'hi'});
let out='';
stream.on('partial', p => out += p.delta);
stream.on('done', () => console.log(out));
```

Elena (docs): Tiny Python snippet (illustrative):
```py
async for ev in client.generate_stream(model='redwood-7b', input='hi'):
    if ev['type']=='partial': text += ev['data']['delta']
    if ev['type']=='done': print(text)
```

Samir (eng-runtime): Please include exact event names 'partial' and 'done' and the data keys we guarantee: text, delta. I'll add a runtime test that asserts those shapes.

Tao (eng-ml): Add a one-line migration note: "If you previously parsed the whole response as JSON, switch to consuming SSE events and assembling deltas, or set stream=false to receive a single JSON response."

Ivy (product): Also add a short troubleshooting tip: common mistake is treating the raw data: line as complete JSON without trimming leading/trailing whitespace and ignoring multiple data: lines per event.

doc-bot: PR opened by Elena (docs) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1999 assigned to Samir (eng-runtime) for review.

Samir (eng-runtime): Reviewing now. I'll push a small test change to integration-tests asserting event names and that data includes text/delta. Will link the test PR after I push.

Elena (docs): Thanks. I'll update the PR with the migration blurb and the tiny troubleshooting note. Will merge after Samir's review and tests are green, then ping SDK owners to refresh language snippets.

Samir (eng-runtime): LGTM pending test. Optional: include a short note about Content-Type values (text/event-stream vs application/json) to make things explicit.

Elena (docs): Good call, adding Content-Type line now. Thanks everyone.
